title: Item:Dissolver
wikitext:
{{History|custom=While they remain in the game and can be bought and sold on the Auction House, Dissolvers were removed from the [[Essence Crafting]] process in [[Update 81]]; new ones cannot now be bought, and existing ones serve no purpose.}}
[[File:Dissolver orb.png]]
[[File:Dissolver store icon.png]]
{{Ingredient | icon = Dissolver icon.png | pic = Dissolver.png | type = raw | cost = 5 pp | weight = 0 | bind = {{Bind|No}} | system = Essence | dropsfrom = | createdfrom = | usedin = | maxstack = 100 | description = This bubbling concoction is used in crafting deconstruction recipes to dissolve effects off of items and reduce them to their base magical essences. | tips = [[File:Dissolver store.png|thumb|Dissolver in the DDO Store]] * 10 Dissolvers cost 50 pp (base price) from Crafting Hall Vendors ([[Courtney d'Cannith]], [[Reginald Belspry]], [[Umbold d'Cannith]], [[Jannice d'Cannith]]) or {{Cost|25|inline=true}} from [[DDO Store]]. * Can only be purchased in multiples of 10. * Can be stored in and used from [[Crafting Storage|Shared Crafting Storage]]. {{Bug|If used this way, the normal [[platinum]] received from dissolving is not granted.}} If stored in a personal [[Inventory system|inventory backpack]] or [[Bags|bag]], platinum can be received. * Dissolving items with augments inserted will destroy the augment.}} * Legacy crafting items {{Item|Parfett's Leading Dissolver}}, {{Item|Lorinda's Ultimate Remover}} and {{Item|Liquid Knife Potion}} can be exchanged 1:1 for Dissolver at any Crafting Hall Vendor by selecting the option to trade essences. == See Also == * [[DDOstore/Crafting#Essence Crafting|Essence Crafting items in the DDO Store]] [[Category:DDO Store items]] [[Category:Essence Crafting]]
